faq.title: Still have questions?
faq.ctaText: See how your own prospecting assignment moves from conversation to export in a demo.
faq.q1: How does an assignment work in BelgoBase?
faq.a1: Tell BelgoBase what your business does or share your website. BelgoBase helps identify suitable customers; you then confirm the target market, research the selection and export the data you need.
faq.q2: Can I use an existing customer list?
faq.a2: Yes. You can temporarily add an Excel or CSV file of up to 5,000 rows and 4 MB. The file is kept for no more than seven days, and the contact rows are not sent to the AI.
faq.q3: What is the difference between Conversation and Workspace?
faq.a3: Conversation helps you define the need and target market in plain language. Workspace shows the selection and gives you direct control over criteria, companies and export. You can move between both.
faq.q4: Which company information can I research?
faq.a4: BelgoBase uses available KBO company data and NBB information. You can review and combine criteria such as activity, region, legal form, FTE and available financial fields.
faq.a5: Yes. You will receive an official invoice. The one-time licence costs €2,995 excl. VAT. There is no subscription; AI and contact usage are paid for separately.
faq.q6: How do AI and voice work?
faq.a6: You can type or speak. BelgoBase uses AI to understand your request and make suggestions for you to review. These features use the separate AI balance for your licence.
faq.a7: Choose the companies and available columns for an Excel export, including company data, financial fields and website data found during the check.
faq.q8: Which contact details can BelgoBase find?
faq.a8: BelgoBase checks available contact details on public company websites. Some companies have no useful website or do not publish contact details, so results vary by selection.
faq.q9: How may I use the data?
faq.a9: BelgoBase is intended for professional B2B prospecting and analysis. You remain responsible for lawful use of the data; the privacy notice explains how BelgoBase processes data.
